notes: Consolidated a further 10 repeated style rules in the Control Panel stylesheet, completing the three-part cleanup started in 1.1.230. 44 of the original 60 groups are now defined once each.

The remaining 16 are staying as they are: in each case another rule sits between the copies and depends on the ordering, so merging them would change how something looks. That is now a measured conclusion rather than an assumption.
Verified the same way as the previous two releases: every element on every Control Panel tab and on Panel Settings compared before and after across all 366 style properties, all 17,301 identical.
Released as 1.1.233 rather than 1.1.232: another change set claimed 1.1.232 first, so this one moved up a number to keep each release describing exactly what it contains.
